name: hylograph-forces
description: d3-force's forces, and six more, in PureScript: the checks against d3-force and the Rust kernel

scripts.build:es: spago build && purs-backend-es build --corefn-dir output --output-dir output-es
scripts.build:kernel: KERNEL="${FORCE_KERNEL:-../../purescript-hylograph-showcases/wasm-force-demo/force-kernel}"; OUT="$PWD/test/kernel-f64"; cd "$KERNEL" && PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir "$OUT" -- --features f64
